events.title_zh: TII 发布面向阿联酋方言与文化的 Falcon-Emirati-7B
events.summary: TII introduced Falcon-Emirati-7B, a regional Arabic model built on Falcon-H1-Arabic-7B with authentic Emirati web data, Modern Standard Arabic cultural material and constrained synthetic data. TII reports 84.83% on Alyah and stronger dialect fidelity than tested alternatives. A public chat is available, but weights, code and an API were not available at review time.

events.title: Mistral previews Large 4 with a 1T-parameter multimodal MoE
events.title_zh: Mistral 预览 1T 参数多模态 MoE 模型 Large 4
events.summary: Mistral opened a public preview API for Large 4, a natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 1.05T total parameters, 49B active parameters and a 1.6B vision encoder. The model combines instruction following, reasoning and agentic capabilities and supports more than 160 languages. Weights and fuller architecture and post-training details are promised by the end of October.

events.title: Anthropic expands cyber access into three verified tiers
events.title_zh: Anthropic 将高级 cyber 能力分为三档验证访问
events.summary_en: Anthropic merged Project Glasswing and its Cyber Verification Program into three verified access tiers. Defense Access, Red Team Access and Specialized Access progressively reduce cyber blocks for authorized work while increasing identity, security-control and monitoring requirements. The program covers Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1 and future models across Claude Platform, Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 将 Project Glasswing 与 Cyber Verification Program 合并为三档验证访问。Defense、Red Team 与 Specialized Access 会随授权范围逐步减少 cyber 拦截，同时提高身份、安全控制与监测要求。该计划覆盖 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Mythos 5.1 及后续模型，并接入 Claude Platform、Vertex AI 和 Microsoft Foundry。
events.why_it_matters_en: For security teams, frontier cyber access is becoming a governed distribution product rather than a blanket model setting. The vendor-reported vulnerability counts are substantial, but retention, authorization and misuse-monitoring boundaries still need contractual review.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对安全团队来说，前沿 cyber 能力正在变成受治理的分发产品，而不是统一的模型开关。厂商报告的漏洞数量很大，但数据保留、授权和滥用监测边界仍需逐项审合同。

technical_details.reported_impact: at least 129,000 verified partner vulnerabilities from April to July plus 5,500 from open-source scanning through October
technical_details.availability: Claude Platform, Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry; Bedrock only with EFS eligibility

events.title: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2 for on-device multimodal retrieval
events.title_zh: Google 发布端侧多模态检索模型 EmbeddingGemma 2
events.summary_en: Google released the Apache 2.0 EmbeddingGemma 2 weights, a 740M-parameter model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one 768-dimensional space. Its modality encoders can be loaded selectively, and Matryoshka training supports 128- to 768-dimensional outputs. Google reports 191 MB active RAM for text-only quantized weights and 567 MB for the full multimodal model on a Pixel 11 Pro.
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 Apache 2.0 的 EmbeddingGemma 2 权重。这个 740M 参数模型把文本、代码、图像、视频和音频映射到同一 768 维空间。各模态编码器可以按需加载，Matryoshka 训练支持 128 至 768 维输出。Google 报告量化后在 Pixel 11 Pro 上，纯文本权重占用约 191 MB 活跃内存，完整多模态模型约 567 MB。
events.why_it_matters_en: For local search and RAG teams, one small open model can replace separate text, image and audio embedding stacks. Vendor benchmarks and device-memory claims still need validation on the target corpus and hardware.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地搜索与 RAG 团队来说，一个小型开放模型可以替代分开的文本、图像和音频嵌入栈。厂商 benchmark 与设备内存数据仍需在目标语料和硬件上复测。

events.title: ScienceClaw tests whether scientific agents retain verified improvements
events.title_zh: ScienceClaw 检验科研 agent 能否保留已验证改进
events.summary_en: ScienceClaw-Eval measures whether a fixed model can turn verified task repairs into persistent Skill and Operator changes across sequential scientific work. It spans 23 disciplines and evaluates correctness, improvement, retention, transfer and cost with reset tests. Public code keeps an update only after replay reproduces the repair and independent tasks improve.
events.summary_zh: ScienceClaw-Eval 检验固定模型能否把已验证的任务修复转成持久的 Skill 与 Operator 更新，并用于后续科研任务。它覆盖 23 个学科，通过重置测试衡量正确性、改进幅度、保留、迁移和成本。公开代码只有在重放能复现修复、且独立任务确实改善时才保留更新。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building self-improving agents, this replaces “the agent wrote a skill” with replay and held-out acceptance gates. Results remain author-reported, and the broad research stack should be isolated before evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建自我改进 agent 的团队来说，这把“agent 写了一个 skill”升级为重放与独立任务验收。结果仍由作者报告，而且公开仓库权限面很宽，评测前应放进隔离环境。

events.title: OpenAI publishes model-generated mathematics with Lean checks
events.title_zh: OpenAI 发布模型生成的数学成果与 Lean 验证
events.summary_en: OpenAI published model-generated mathematical results with Lean formalizations and a public revision history. On October 7 it withdrew three manuscripts after a sign error invalidated one construction and two dependent papers, repaired fourteen others, updated thirteen dependencies and raised top-line Lean coverage to 300 of 719 results.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布模型生成的数学成果、Lean 形式化与公开修订记录。10 月 7 日，团队因一个符号错误使核心构造和两篇依赖论文失效，撤回三篇稿件；另修订 14 篇、更新 13 篇依赖，并将 top-line 结果的 Lean 覆盖提高到 719 项中的 300 项。
events.why_it_matters_en: For AI-for-math teams, the withdrawals show why formal coverage, dependency tracking and independent expert review must be release gates rather than optional evidence. The transparent correction process is useful, but the unavailable model and substantial proof repairs keep the work at WATCH.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 AI 数学团队来说，这次撤稿说明形式化覆盖、依赖追踪和独立专家复核必须成为发布闸门，而不是可选证据。公开纠错流程值得肯定，但模型未开放且修订规模较大，仍应列为 WATCH。

events.title: Unofficial GLM-5.3 derivative targets two DGX Spark systems
events.title_zh: 非官方 GLM-5.3 衍生模型面向双 DGX Spark
events.summary: An unofficial derivative prunes GLM-5.3-Flash from 288 to 224 routed experts and quantizes routed experts to NVFP4, producing a 141 GiB weight footprint intended for two DGX Spark systems. The card reports benchmarks from a B200, not the target Spark hardware, and explicitly labels Spark throughput and memory behavior as estimates.
events.summary_zh: 一个非官方衍生版本把 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 routed expert 从 288 个裁到 224 个，并把 routed expert 量化为 NVFP4，权重约 141 GiB，目标是两台 DGX Spark。模型卡的 benchmark 来自 B200，而不是目标 Spark；Spark 的吞吐与内存表现被明确标为估算。
events.why_it_matters: For most teams, this is a narrow, expensive deployment recipe whose central target claim has not been measured on the target hardware. High community interest does not justify engineering investment until independent two-Spark results and quality regressions are available.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对多数团队来说，这是面向小众且昂贵硬件组合的部署配方，核心主张还没有在目标硬件上实测。社区热度不能替代证据；在出现独立的双 Spark 结果和质量回归前，不值得投入工程时间。
